title: Annual gasoline-price waterfall
intent: Show how annual changes bridge from the 2004 U.S. gasoline price to the net change in 2010.

ai.create: Create a waterfall chart by deriving year-over-year gasoline-price changes from the driving dataset, accumulating explicit start and end intervals, and distinguishing increases, decreases, and the net change.
ai.maintain: Change the year window while retaining source fields through the difference transform, stable year identity, the zero-based final total, and inferred interval channels.
